source.product: Ensure Plus Advance 220 mL drink containing 1.5 g calcium-HMB

population_design.population: healthy older women over 65 attending mild fitness twice weekly
population_design.control: no drink, placebo or matched nutrition product
population_design.blinding: open label; outcome staff asked not to learn allocation
population_design.registration: posted after enrollment began; first submission 2014-04-16; first posting 2014-04-21 estimated
population_design.malignancy_exclusion: history/evidence of malignancy in prior 5 years except non-melanoma skin neoplasia

safety.generalizability_limit: recent malignancy and renal failure excluded

competitive_disposition.category: low-cost oral muscle-function alternative / rejected-routes table
competitive_disposition.reason: primary SPPB null; open-label drink versus no-treatment control; multiple unadjusted secondary findings; adult healthy population; no BUBR1 or MVA evidence
competitive_disposition.relative_to_apitegromab: more scalable oral format, but weaker design and no pediatric disease-matched evidence

identity.title: Effect of Oral Beta-Hydroxy-Beta-Methylbutyrate (HMB) Supplementation on Physical Performance in Healthy Old Women Over 65 Years: An Open Label Randomized Controlled Trial

identity.briefTitle: Assessment of Physical Performance With A Supplementation Containing HMB in a Sample of Old Women in Good Health

relationship_to_existing_route: Distinct 2015 HMB-containing drink and cohort; it supplements, but does not replace or replicate, the later Kyowa calcium-HMB powder trial. No unique compound/decision row is added.
abstract_screen_ref: outcome-first batch 12, order 102, MED:26529601; abstract lane H_CF.
